core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Habil corresponds to the Arabic form هابيل (Arabic هابيل (Hābīl) < Hebrew הֶבֶל (Hevel)). Its core sense is abel (habīl / hābīl, son of adam). Habil is a transliteration of هابيل (Hābīl), the Arabic form of the name Abel. The source gloss claimed the sense 'Abel's brother' — in fact Hābīl IS Abel, and his brother is Qābīl (Cain); the gloss has been corrected. Same name as habeel.
